meta.name: yamazato_bonsho
meta.prompt: A feudal Japanese hill village of terraced paddies, with a great bronze temple bell in its own pavilion on the ridge above, rung at dusk.

programs.brief: A monumental open-sided Japanese temple bell pavilion (shōrō) on a stepped stone plinth, with massive dark cedar corner columns, intricate bracket complexes (dougong), and a sweeping hipped tile roof with flared eaves. Suspended from the heavy central beam is a massive cast bronze temple bell (bonshō) with lotus reliefs and a horizontal suspended log striker (shumoku) hung on ropes beside it.

tokens.terrain: a steep terraced hillside rising from a valley to a high ridge above
tokens.icons: a great bronze temple bell housed in an open-sided timber pavilion on the high ridge overlooking the village; flooded stepped rice paddies with stone and clay retaining bunds stepped down the slope
tokens.infra: paddy_bunds terraced down the slopes around the settlement; stone_stairway climbing the hillside to the ridge bell pavilion
